Thanks — cc'd procurement and Sam (our CDN partner) who may have integration notes.

I attached an updated MAP (MAP_BrightBridge_v1.3.xlsx) with an owners worksheet and a compact action table. High-level owners:
- SDK integration / streaming SDK: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai)
- Auth / SSO + key management: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai)
- Tool calling / function routing: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai)
- Program lead / MAP owner: Ava Chen (me)

1) Auth e2e with BrightBridge IdP test creds (blocked until procurement finalizes contract for test key access) — owner: Rishi — target: 2027-10-20
2) Streaming backpressure and retry policy confirmation for long-lived connections — owner: Ben — target: 2027-10-18 for spec, 2027-11-01 for tests
3) Tool-calling schema and security review (SOW alignment) — owner: Monica — target: 2027-10-14 for initial schema

Action items in the sheet are row-level with owners, priority, and expected close date. I also included a simple evaluation plan section (pass/fail tests for SDK, auth smoke, streaming throughput) to gate the pilot.

See attached: MAP_BrightBridge_v1.3.xlsx; auth_flow_diagram.png is also attached for quick reference.

Next steps:
- Confirm Tuesday cadence and attendee list (BrightBridge: Elena + PM; Redwood: Ben, Rishi, Monica, Ava)
- Procurement to share required procurement docs by end of this week so Rishi can begin IdP test setup

If that works, I’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda template.

Thanks — Ava

Quick technical note on streaming & SDK items — pulling out the key points I’ll cover in the first checkpoint:

1) SDK: we have a minimal JS/Go SDK for streaming with automatic reconnect + KV cache support. We need to agree on minimum bandwidth and TTL defaults for BrightBridge workloads. Action: Ben to produce a 1-page SDK compatibility matrix by 2027-10-12.

2) Streaming backpressure: two modes we can offer — (a) server-buffered with token-based flow control, (b) client-driven windowing. For low-latency interactive UIs we recommend option (b), but it requires client buffering logic. Action: Ben + BrightBridge infra engineer to test both modes on 10/19.

3) Auth: Rishi will call out required header formats and test JWTs. Rishi, please flag any KMS/HSM requirements in the MAP so procurement can surface them.

I’ve created INTEG-442 in Jira to track the streaming test plan and linked it in the MAP.

- Ben
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks — a couple of notes from the CDN/edge side that could affect streaming resilience and the pilot timeline:

- We can support sticky connections for streaming if the client includes a stable session id. If BrightBridge expects server-side fanout, that adds ~1–2 days of integration work on our side for connection routing.
- TLS client-certificate mode is supported (helps with mutual TLS requirement you alluded to in procurement). If you plan to use mTLS, Rishi, we should coordinate cert rotation cadence and whether Redwood will accept our intermediate CA.

I’ll join the first Tuesday sync (tentative). I can also provide a short spec doc for session routing by 2027-10-13.

— Sam
Integration Lead, CloudVendor Networks
[Attachment: CDN_session_routing_notes.txt (txt)]
